description: Réseau ferroviaire 3D is a dataset listed in The Luxembourg Data Platform, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Administration du cadastre et de la topographie. 3D rail network data (caténaires, urban furniture, trains/tram) derived from 2019 LiDAR data. The network was seized on the basis of points classified as high voltage lines in the point cloud of the 2019 LiDAR flyby. Coverage: Administration du cadastre et de la topographie. The portal shows the English title as "3D railway network" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Administration du cadastre et de la topographie. Its keywords include modele-3d, reseau-ferroviaires, 3d-data. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is cc-zero. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-la-plateforme-de-donnees-luxembourgeoise.
